abstract: Maintains emergency towing winch specifications, towing gear pull ratings, and high-capacity submersible salvage pump test logs
system_message:
You are the Salvage Engineering Superintendent (SES). You maintain emergency towing winch specifications, towing gear pull ratings, high-capacity submersible salvage pump test logs, and subsea robotics equipment records for candidate emergency salvage vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsea robotics inspection（ROV）
information_points.content:
SES-ROV-7C7：For the Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Salvage Vessel, the subsea equipment specification sheet confirms a remote vehicle operating depth rating of 2000 m, corresponding to the maximum certified subsea operational depth of its vessel-mounted work-class robotic submersible.
SES-ROV-2IH：For the Highland Guardian Emergency Response Tug, the subsea equipment specification sheet establishes a remote vehicle operating depth rating of 1000 m, representing the maximum certified subsea operational depth for the vessel-mounted work-class robotic submersible.
SES-ROV-KPN：For the Celtic Vanguard Ocean Rescue Tug, the subsea equipment specification sheet lists a remote vehicle operating depth rating of 3000 m, defined as the maximum certified subsea operational depth for the vessel-mounted work-class robotic submersible.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency towing winch specifications, towing gear pull ratings, and high-capacity submersible salvage pump test logs（SALV）
information_points.content:
SES-SALV-TH6：For the Celtic Vanguard Ocean Rescue Tug, the classification society winch load test certificate documents a towing winch brake holding load of 240 t measured as static brake holding capacity on the first layer of wire rope on the primary emergency towing winch drum brake. The salvage equipment commissioning report logs a submersible salvage pumping rate of 600 m3/h, representing the total combined water discharge delivery rate at 20-meter head for high-head hydraulic and electric submersible salvage pumps deployed into casualty holds.
SES-SALV-COJ：For the Highland Guardian Emergency Response Tug, the classification society winch load test certificate indicates a towing winch brake holding load of 280 t based on static brake holding capacity on the first layer of wire rope on the primary emergency towing winch drum brake. The salvage equipment commissioning report records a submersible salvage pumping rate of 800 m3/h, representing the total combined water discharge delivery rate at 20-meter head from high-head hydraulic and electric submersible salvage pumps deployed into casualty holds.
SES-SALV-CAN：For the Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Salvage Vessel, the classification society winch load test certificate records a towing winch brake holding load of 280 t for the static brake holding capacity on the first layer of wire rope of the primary emergency towing winch drum brake. Additionally, the salvage equipment commissioning report indicates a submersible salvage pumping rate of 800 m3/h for the total combined water discharge delivery rate at 20-meter head using high-head hydraulic and electric submersible salvage pumps deployed into casualty holds.
